Saving Harmony Update: New Features and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Saving Harmony has been improved with new features and bug fixes:

New features
- added a secret unlockable item when you complete game for all characters
- added log book content for each character
- added icon to display when you can't pick up wood or 
- improved interfaces
- improved game over screen
- improved item usage
- improved sound mixing
 
Fixed bugs 
- fixed mini game pay out
- fixed menu 
- fixed torch
